content: DRAFT If EthSM WakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and the EthSM statmachine is in state ETHSM_ STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK, and ComM request now COMM_FULL_COMMUNICAT ION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.

If EthSM WakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and the EthSM statmachine is in state ETHSM_ STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK, and ComM request now COMM_FULL_COMMUNICAT ION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQ UEST, then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.

If EthSM WakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and the EthSM statmachine is in state ETHSM_ STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK, and ComM request now COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.
